body:
## Pull request overview

This PR restructures the Console roadmap (ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md) by replacing the flat Phase 10a/10b structure with a progressive maturity model spanning 9 feature-area phases (10-18). Each phase implements a "shallow to deep" approach with L1 (Foundation) → L2 (Production) → L3 (Excellence) stages, enabling incremental development of UX gaps identified through Airtable benchmarking.

**Changes:**
- Introduced 9 new phases (10-18) covering Data Interaction, Grid Excellence, Record Detail, Kanban, Forms, Import/Export, Undo/Redo, Collaboration, and Automation
- Added L1/L2/L3 maturity levels with detailed acceptance criteria and spec compliance references for each feature area
- Updated execution timeline and milestone roadmap mapping features to v1.0 (Phases 10-12), v1.1 (Phases 13-15), v1.2 (Phases 16-17), and v2.0 (Phase 18)
- Expanded UI Feature Roadmap tables (sections 5.1-5.7) with new Kanban, Collaboration, and Automation subsections
- Added 108 measurable success criteria across all L1/L2/L3 levels in section 11

The text contains Chinese characters "由浅入深" which violates the English-only codebase requirement. Per Coding Guideline #-1, all user-facing text, documentation, and comments must be in English to ensure global accessibility. The English translation "shallow to deep" is already provided and should be used alone.

The phase reference for Excel/PDF export is inconsistent. The feature is defined in Phase 10.3 L2 (Grid Export) and Phase 15.2 L2 (Universal Export), but this table entry incorrectly references "Phase 11 (L2)". Phase 11 is about Grid Excellence (frozen columns, row grouping), not export features. This should be either "Phase 10 (L2)" for Grid-specific export or "Phase 15 (L2)" for universal export across all views.
```suggestion
| **Export (Excel, PDF)** | 🔲 Planned | Post v1.0 | Phase 10 (L2) |
```
